artifact_validation_script.source:
import json,re,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/mac/Desktop/cloudphone-risk-detector')
report=json.loads(Path('/tmp/cprisk-gep-v2-stack/report.json').read_text());build=Path(report['build_directory'])
llvm=Path('/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@22/bin')
out={'commands':[], 'scope':'macOS arm64 stack final machine code and corrupted-result rejection'}
def run(args):
 p=subprocess.run([str(a) for a in args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
 out['commands'].append({'argv':[str(a) for a in args],'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout if len(p.stdout)<5000 else '(saved separately)','stderr':p.stderr})
 return p
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
p=run([llvm/'llvm-objdump','--disassemble',build/'differential']);assert p.returncode==0
(build/'final.asm').write_text(p.stdout)
checks={}
for name in ('vm_stack_crypto_init','vm_stack_encrypt_push','vm_stack_push_encrypted'):
 symbol='protected_'+name
 m=re.search(r'^[0-9a-f]+ <_'+symbol+r'>:\n(.*?)(?=^[0-9a-f]+ <|\Z)',p.stdout,re.M|re.S);assert m,symbol
 calls=[l.strip() for l in m.group(1).splitlines() if re.search(r'\bbl\b.*<___vm_engine>',l)]
 assert calls,symbol
 checks[symbol]=calls
out['machine_code']={'wrapper_engine_calls':checks,'assembly_path':str(build/'final.asm'),'assembly_sha256':sha(build/'final.asm'),'executable_sha256':sha(build/'differential')}
ir=(build/'optimized.ll').read_text()
pat=r'(^define[^\n]*@protected_vm_stack_crypto_init\([^\n]*\)[^\n]*\{\n)(.*?)(^\})'
m=re.search(pat,ir,re.M|re.S);assert m
body,count=re.subn(r'^(\s*)ret i32 ([%\w.]+)$',r'\1%cprisk_negative = xor i32 \2, 1\n\1ret i32 %cprisk_negative',m.group(2),flags=re.M);assert count==1,count
negative=ir[:m.start(2)]+body+ir[m.end(2):]
(build/'negative.ll').write_text(negative)
assert run([llvm/'opt','-passes=verify','-disable-output',build/'negative.ll']).returncode==0
assert run([llvm/'clang','-O0','-c',build/'negative.ll','-o',build/'negative.o']).returncode==0
assert run([llvm/'clang','-O2',root/'experiments/ir-vmp/differential.c',build/'plain.o',build/'negative.o','-o',build/'negative']).returncode==0
p=run([build/'negative']);assert p.returncode!=0 and 'FAIL' in p.stderr
out['negative_control']={'mutation':'XOR final i32 return of protected_vm_stack_crypto_init with 1','mutated_returns':count,'negative_ir_sha256':sha(build/'negative.ll'),'rejected':True,'result':out['commands'][-1]}
Path('/tmp/cprisk-gep-v2-stack-artifacts.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'machine_wrappers_checked':len(checks),'corrupted_result_rejected':True,'failure':p.stderr.strip()}))
